clue.text: Top people having some bread with evening meal, but no starter

indicators.note: no starter means the word for the evening meal loses its opening letter

parts.note: supper is an evening meal
a crust is a piece of bread, its hard outer part

explanation.surface: Posh folk being served bread alongside their dinner, though the first course is skipped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but no starter' strips S from SUPPER, leaving UPPER; 'Top people' looks like a description of diners but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the upper crust is the aristocracy, the highest social class.

clue.text: Escort female into city of old

indicators.note: into says the word for female is placed within the name of the ancient city

parts.note: Ur is the ancient Sumerian city in Mesopotamia
she is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A woman is escorted into an ancient city.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to usher someone is to escort or guide them to a place.

clue.text: Poem father introduces is read lots in translation

indicators.note: father introduces the rest, so his letters come first

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

indicators.note: a translation turns the words into something new, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A father presents a poem that is widely read in translation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in translation' looks like part of the poem's story, but it is the signal to shuffle IS READ LOTS, which 'introduces' places after the father.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Milton's epic about the Fall of Man is a famous poem.

clue.text: Complain loudly in bar

definitions.meaning: a rod or bar, as on a fence or a railway track

explanation.surface: Someone kicking up a fuss in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a verb meaning to protest angrily, and a noun meaning a horizontal rod.

clue.text: Ignore newly-developed area

indicators.note: something newly developed has been reshaped, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A planning complaint: a freshly built-up district being overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a region is a district or zone of land.

clue.text: Most clever son taking early spring exam?

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
Mar is the abbreviation for March, a month early in spring
a test is an exam

explanation.surface: A bright boy sitting an exam ahead of schedule in spring.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: smartest is the superlative of smart, meaning brightest.

clue.text: Produced German wine when entertaining one young lady from Strasbourg?

parts.note: made means produced

indicators.note: the wine entertains one, holding it within as a host holds a guest

parts.note: Moselle is a white wine from the Mosel valley in Germany
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone made German wine while hosting a young woman from Alsace.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the definition by example: Strasbourg is in France, where a young unmarried woman is addressed this way.
explanation.definitionFit: Translation: the French title for an unmarried young woman, used of a girl from a French city.

clue.text: Democratic leaders identify tyrant

indicators.note: the leaders of the word Democratic are its opening letters

parts.note: to spot is to identify or pick out

explanation.surface: A political warning: those at the head of a party unmasking a dictator.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 'leaders' takes the first two letters, DE, not just one.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a despot is an absolute ruler who wields power cruelly.

clue.text: Swimmer going off course near entrance to harbour

indicators.note: the entrance to the word harbour is its first letter

parts.note: erring means straying from the right path

explanation.surface: A boat drifting off course just outside the harbour mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword-style sense: any fish is a swimmer, and this one is a common North Atlantic food fish.

clue.text: American Indian disposes of horse quickly

indicators.note: disposes of says one piece is thrown out of the longer word

parts.note: the Apache are a Native American people
horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

explanation.surface: A Native American rider getting rid of his horse in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: H for 'horse' comes by way of heroin, for which both are slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: apace is a literary word meaning swiftly or at speed.

clue.text: Journey I had taken through Renfrewshire's borders

indicators.note: the contraction is carried through the gap between the two border letters
the borders of Renfrewshire are its first and last letters

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: A traveller recalls a trip across the edges of a Scottish county.
explanation.walkthrough: Renfrewshire is a county in west-central Scotland; its borders, ignoring the 's, are R and E.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a ride is a trip or journey, often on a horse or in a vehicle.

clue.text: Keep secret wine container, say, at university

parts.note: a bottle is an example of a container for wine
up means in residence at a university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student hiding a bottle of wine in college.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to bottle up feelings or news is to keep them hidden.

clue.text: New fort constructed to protect eastern port in Sierra Leone

indicators.note: the rebuilt letters protect the extra letter by surrounding it
constructed means put together anew, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new fort being built to guard the eastern side of a West African harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the capital of Sierra Leone is a major Atlantic seaport.

clue.text: For him principally money is so essential, right?

definitions.text: For him principally money is so essential, right?

indicators.note: principally means taking the leading letter of each word that follows

explanation.surface: A question about someone for whom cash matters above all.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and a description of a hoarder.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a man who values money above everything is a skinflint who hoards his wealth.

clue.text: Phone spy about British head of intelligence

indicators.note: about says the spy goes around the other letters

parts.note: a mole is a spy planted inside an organisation

indicators.note: the head of intelligence is its first letter

explanation.surface: A double agent snooping around the chief of British intelligence.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a mobile is a cellphone, the British name for a portable phone.

clue.text: Corpulent porter

explanation.surface: A description of a fat railway porter.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an adjective for plump, and a dark beer brewed with roasted malt.

clue.text: Some remember that woman's name

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A reminder to recall what a woman is called.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a traditional female given name of Germanic origin.

clue.text: Maybe Christian always is behind bishop and priest

indicators.note: is behind means this word follows the others

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
Eli is the priest in the Old Testament who raised Samuel
ever means always

explanation.surface: A churchgoer who always trails behind the clergy.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Christian is one kind of person of religious faith.

clue.text: Man, for example, first to vacate gangway

indicators.note: first to vacate means the opening letter leaves the word

parts.note: an aisle is a gangway between rows of seats

explanation.surface: A man being the first to clear a gangway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like a person, but it is the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Isle of Man is an island between Britain and Ireland.

clue.text: Bird, say, about to perch on top of tree

indicators.note: in a down entry these pieces perch on top of the last letter

parts.note: eg means for example, which say signals
re means about, concerning

indicators.note: the top of tree is its first letter

explanation.surface: A bird about to land on a treetop.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the egret is a white heron.

clue.text: Run ahead of expert in athletics event

indicators.note: ahead of means this letter comes first

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Running in front of a star performer at a track meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sprint on the track is a kind of athletics contest.

clue.text: Rope — look — restraining donkey

indicators.note: restraining means holding the other word within

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A cowboy scene: a rope holding back a donkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a lasso is a rope with a noose for catching animals.

clue.text: Cinema advertisement for caravan

definitions.meaning: a preview of a coming film shown before the feature
a vehicle towed behind a car, which is also a camping caravan

explanation.surface: An advert at the pictures for a mobile home.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a film preview and a towed vehicle for living in.

clue.text: Pre-wedding fight?

definitions.meaning: the period of a formal promise to marry, before the wedding

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the betrothal before a marriage, and a battle between armed forces.
